entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help. I bought a ProFit jersey a couple of weeks ago, and I need to return it. I've been a loyal customer for years and I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your order number?
Yes, it's VF58291. I was just so excited for it, but... it's not right.

Thank you. I see the order for the ProFit Jersey, delivered on November 25th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's just the wrong size. I followed the chart, but it's much too tight across the shoulders. I feel terrible about it, but I can't wear it.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. It sounds like you need a different size. I'm just pulling up our policy information now... one moment.
Please, I was so worried I would be stuck with it, and with the holidays coming up, I really needed this money back if it didn't fit.

I understand completely. And good news, I've checked the policy. Since you're within the 90-day return window, we can definitely process this for you. We can either do a full refund or an exchange for a different size.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you! I think I'd like to do an exchange for one size up, if possible.

Absolutely. I can initiate that exchange for you right now. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email. Just pack up the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once they scan it, we'll ship out the new size to you.
That's perfect. You've been so helpful, Sarah. Thank you so much!
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've saved my day.
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
